model.title: Parents Opt-in Protection Act
model.meta: Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Mary Miller (R-IL)

summary.text: The bill would require schools to obtain written permission from parents before subjecting students to surveys, analyses, or evaluations that ask about personal information regarding the student or their family.
